taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Argo CD project repositories, destinations and controller delegation
controls.source_trace: Follow application source/destination and project selection into resources the controller applies. Inspect who may modify the project or privileged application fields.
controls.implementation_branch: Evaluate AppProject source repositories, destinations, resource allowlists and repository/controller credentials together. A project allowing a namespace may still need to restrict cluster-scoped resources and destination identity. Argo CD administrative editing is not an unprivileged bypass; demonstrate the authority of the actual application author and the rendered resources the controller will apply.
controls.operational_method: Check who may edit AppProject versus who may select Application.spec.project. Inspect destination namespace as a security capability: deployment into the Argo CD installation namespace can permit control over Argo resources, even with a restricted source list. Trace permitted rendered resources into controller/app credentials and project admission without applying them to production. Source allowlisting alone does not establish safety of an administrative destination.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated GitOps fixture and inert manifests; compare permitted application sync with a forbidden repo/namespace/resource selection.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Read access to an application or a powerful controller identity is not escalation if application/project mutation is denied.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain project/application authority and final cluster admission, retesting legitimate reconciliation and forbidden destinations.
